adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the handler builds `EventManager` using the acting user (`ctx.user`) and `getUsersCredentials(ctx.user)`, then calls `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)`. Although the booking query includes `booking.user.credentials`, those organizer credentials are never used. This means if someone other than the organizer (e.g., an attendee or team admin) triggers `addGuests`, the calendar update will run with the wrong credentials and may fail to update the organizer’s connected calendar.
